name: Claude CLI
description: Start a Claude AI conversation in your terminal. Installs Claude CLI and launches an interactive session.
setupSteps: Authenticate via SSO: claude auth login  (opens browser for OAuth)
Start a session: claude  (or use the template button)

name: System Monitor
description: Launch htop for real-time process monitoring.
setupSteps: Install htop if needed: sudo apt-get install htop
Press q or F10 to quit.

name: Python REPL
setupSteps: Type exit() or Ctrl+D to quit.

name: Nano Lang REPL
description: Start the nanolang interactive REPL (requires nanolang installed).
setupSteps: Type :help for REPL commands. :load to load .nano files. :reload for hot-reload.

name: SSH Agent
description: Start ssh-agent and add your default key for passwordless auth.
setupSteps: Ensure ssh-agent is available: which ssh-agent
